Categorical bar: any column on the x axis.

``orientation: "horizontal"`` draws ranked lists with long labels the
readable way (bars run left to right, labels get a full line each).

cross_filters.description: Superset cross-filtering on this dashboard: clicking a value in one chart filters every other chart whose dataset has that column (across tabs). Default off, matching what the tool has always written; set true to turn it on. Spec-owned, so a UI toggle shows up as drift in `plan` and is repaired by `apply`.
cross_filters.title: Cross Filters

label_colors.description: A fixed colour per series label on every chart of the dashboard, e.g. {"Revenue": "#1FA8C9"}. Superset otherwise assigns colours as the page loads, so a measure can change colour between charts and visits; these win over the scheme and the per-view map (6.1.0 applyColors).
label_colors.title: Label Colors

DatasetRef.description:
A dataset is referenced, never created. Names alone are not unique
across databases/schemas, so the reference is a triple.

table.description: Dataset (table) name as registered in Superset
table.title: Table

DatasetRef.title: DatasetRef

DesignConfig.description:
Per-dashboard design-brain settings (see docs/DESIGN-BRAIN.md).

Additive and optional: a spec without this block behaves exactly as
before. `ignore` entries are rule ids ('size.pie-geometry'), optionally
scoped to one chart ('size.pie-geometry@Sales by Region'); suppressed
findings are still reported as ignored, so silence stays visible.
DesignConfig.title: DesignConfig

FormatRule.description:
One solid colour band on one metric: green / amber / red, or any
#RRGGBB. A pivot colours a cell by its OWN value only, so band a
normalized metric (e.g. a %-of-goal ratio) when thresholds differ per
row. A table can read one column and paint another (apply_to): colour a
number by a status column beside it.

metric.description: Display label of the metric (table: or column) whose value is tested
metric.title: Metric

color.description: green, amber or red (Superset's own picker colours; text paint uses a darker shade of each), or any #RRGGBB, used as written for cell and text
color.title: Color

apply_to.description: Table only: the label of the column to paint, or "row"; default the metric's own cells
apply_to.title: Apply To

paint.description: Paint the cell background (default) or the text, e.g. an arrow
paint.title: Paint

FormatRule.title: FormatRule

MixedChart.description:
Bars and a line on two value axes (Superset's Mixed Chart), e.g. revenue
as bars with revenue per order as a line. ``x_column`` is a time column (bucketed
by ``time_grain``) or any column (a categorical axis, e.g. by cause). ``a`` and
``b`` are the two queries; the chart's own ``filters`` apply to both.

RangeFilter.description:
Native filter bar: numeric range on one dataset column (filter_range).

``le``/``ge`` set the DEFAULT bound(s) users see on load. One bound gives a
single-handle slider (Superset's single-value mode); both give a range;
equal bounds give exact-match mode. ``charts`` scopes the filter to the
named charts only (default: every chart), resolved to slice ids after
import, since ids don't exist at compile time.

charts.description: Chart names this filter governs; omit for all charts
charts.title: Charts

RangeFilter.title: RangeFilter

SelectFilter.description:
Native filter bar: value picker over one dataset column.

``default`` pre-selects values on load (viewers can still change them); a
relative value such as "This year" keeps a default right as time passes, where
a literal year would go stale. ``charts`` scopes the filter to the named charts
only (default: every chart), resolved to slice ids after import, as on range.

default.description: Values selected on load; omit for none
default.title: Default

default_to_first.description: Select the first value on load (Superset's own option; with sort_descending that is the latest of sortable values like '2026 (this year)', so it never goes stale)
default_to_first.title: Default To First

sort_descending.description: List (and pick the first of) the values Z-A
sort_descending.title: Sort Descending

required.description: A value must stay selected (no empty filter)
required.title: Required

charts.description: Chart names this filter governs; omit for all charts
charts.title: Charts

SelectFilter.title: SelectFilter

tabs.description: Sub-tabs (one level), instead of rows / sketch

TimeRangeFilter.description:
Native filter bar: dashboard-wide time range picker.

``default`` is a Superset time-range expression (``"Last month"``,
``"2026-05-01 : 2026-06-01"``) that pre-fills the picker on load; viewers
can still change it. Omitted, the picker starts empty (Superset shows
"No filter").
